findings.highlight: the sounds of crawling worms
findings.evidenceJa: 無数の蟲が体を引きずる音、数多の蟲が壁を這っていく音
findings.governingReading: Sakura recognizes both countless worms dragging their bodies and multitudes crawling along the walls.
findings.explanation: The English collapses two distinct sounds, motions, quantities, and surfaces into generic crawling.

findings.highlight: This green room
findings.evidenceJa: この緑色の闇だった
findings.governingReading: The first chamber given to Sakura was this green darkness.
findings.explanation: The English turns the engulfing sensory image into the room’s ordinary color.

findings.highlight: did not have the aptitude to become a Master
findings.evidenceJa: マスターとしての適性はなく
findings.governingReading: Shirou has no aptitude in the role or capacity of Master.
findings.explanation: The English reframes present unsuitability as inability to become one later.

findings.highlight: not what she expected
findings.evidenceJa: 予想とは少しだけ違っていた
findings.governingReading: Zouken’s answer differs only slightly from Sakura’s expectation.
findings.explanation: The English removes the crucial “slightly,” overstating how surprising his cruelty is to her.

findings.highlight: When teaching her the family’s magic, he is an inhuman monster
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐の魔術を“教育”する時は人間性などなく
findings.governingReading: During what the Matou call “education” in their magecraft, Zouken possesses no humanity.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the accusing scare quotes and adds the noun “monster.”

findings.highlight: as cruel as a beast
findings.evidenceJa: 獣か虫の残忍さしか持ち合わせない
findings.governingReading: Zouken then possesses only the cruelty of a beast or an insect.
findings.explanation: The English omits the insect comparison that connects him to the worms.

findings.highlight: he becomes just a good-natured old man
findings.evidenceJa: 好々爺めいた親しさを感じさせる
findings.governingReading: In ordinary conversation he can make Sakura feel an intimacy resembling that of a genial old grandfather.
findings.explanation: The English states that he becomes good-natured, weakening the deceptive impression and Sakura’s felt intimacy.

findings.highlight: She is impure
findings.evidenceJa: 自分は汚泥に塗れている
findings.governingReading: Sakura imagines herself physically smeared in filthy mud.
findings.explanation: The English turns her concrete, abject self-image into a generic moral label.

findings.highlight: stand next to him
findings.evidenceJa: 彼の隣に座る
findings.governingReading: Sakura imagines that a more suitable person must sit beside Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English changes the domestic, settled image of sitting at his side into merely standing nearby.

findings.highlight: It’ll all be ruined if she wishes for anything more
findings.evidenceJa: それ以上の幸福など、求めては破滅する
findings.governingReading: Seeking happiness beyond merely remaining near Shirou will bring ruin.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the object of desire vague and makes an existing “all” get ruined rather than desire itself leading to destruction.

findings.highlight: prepared for re-education
findings.evidenceJa: 祖父の反感を買ってしまうことを覚悟して
findings.governingReading: Sakura braces herself to incur her grandfather’s hostility.
findings.explanation: A conditional English variant replaces emotional retaliation with a specific punitive re-education procedure.

findings.highlight: The fear of being thrown to the worms, of losing one’s sensation
findings.evidenceJa: ここで逆らうことが何を意味しているか、彼女はよく知っていた
findings.governingReading: Sakura knows well what defying Zouken here means, but this line leaves the punishment implicit.
findings.explanation: The English inserts being thrown to worms and losing sensation as explicit facts.

findings.highlight: The longest she was able to keep her sanity was two hours
findings.evidenceJa: ここで逆らうことが何を意味しているか、彼女はよく知っていた
findings.governingReading: The Japanese supplies no quantified history of Sakura’s endurance here.
findings.explanation: The English invents an exact two-hour sanity limit.

findings.highlight: at worst until the Holy Grail War ends
findings.evidenceJa: ここで逆らうことが何を意味しているか、彼女はよく知っていた
findings.governingReading: The source does not specify the punishment’s duration or predict madness through the war.
findings.explanation: The English adds prolonged torture and loss-of-sanity projections.

findings.highlight: Her body trembles
findings.evidenceJa: 手足が震える
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s hands and feet tremble.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the localized extremity response to her whole body.

findings.highlight: Fear of punishment makes her want to scream
findings.evidenceJa: 恐怖で泣きだしそうになる
findings.governingReading: Fear brings Sakura close to crying.
findings.explanation: A conditional English variant specifies punishment and changes incipient tears into screaming.

findings.highlight: I cannot force you and lose my valuable successor
findings.evidenceJa: 無理強いをし、大事な後継者を失う訳にはいかん
findings.governingReading: Zouken says he cannot afford to force Sakura and thereby lose his valuable successor.
findings.explanation: The English can read as inability to force her, weakening his calculated choice based on preserving an asset.

findings.highlight: I shall remain an observer as well in this war
findings.evidenceJa: 今回も傍観に徹するとしよう
findings.governingReading: Zouken proposes that this time too they will devote themselves to observing.
findings.explanation: The English omits that passivity repeats an established pattern.

findings.highlight: he has accepted her excuse
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の言い分を受け入れてくれた
findings.governingReading: Zouken appears to accept Sakura’s stated position or plea.
findings.explanation: “Excuse” casts her refusal as pretext and adds a pejorative judgment.

findings.highlight: that defenseless mind
findings.evidenceJa: 無防備になった心
findings.governingReading: Zouken’s voice enters Sakura’s heart precisely when relief has left it defenseless.
findings.explanation: The English relocates emotional vulnerability to cognition.

findings.highlight: Looking at all the Masters in this war, the daughter of Tohsaka is looking pretty good
findings.evidenceJa: 今回の依り代の中では、遠坂の娘はなかなかに上級
findings.governingReading: Among this war’s vessels, Rin is quite high-grade.
findings.explanation: The English identifies the vessels as Masters and reduces technical rank to casual attractiveness or performance.

findings.highlight: passes through as if it’s natural
findings.evidenceJa: 颯爽と通り過ぎていく
findings.governingReading: In Sakura’s resentful image, Rin sweeps dashingly past after obtaining everything.
findings.explanation: The English omits the brilliance and confidence that make Rin painful to watch.

findings.highlight: She’s used to such treatment
findings.evidenceJa: そんなもの、もうとっくに慣れたんだ
findings.governingReading: Sakura insists she became accustomed to “that sort of thing” long ago.
findings.explanation: The English concretizes the object as treatment, narrowing the deliberately diffuse accumulated pain.

findings.highlight: the bright future ahead of her
findings.evidenceJa: 憎み続けてきた輝かしい未来
findings.governingReading: Sakura includes the radiant future she has gone on hating among everything Rin possesses and erases from her sight.
findings.explanation: The English makes it a bright future ahead of Sakura and deletes the hatred defining her envy of Rin.

findings.highlight: The words make her dizzy and nauseous
findings.evidenceJa: 目眩を覚えて、彼女は吐いた
findings.governingReading: The words make Sakura dizzy and she vomits.
findings.explanation: The English reduces an enacted physical symptom to feeling nauseated.

findings.highlight: sleeping on an operating table
findings.evidenceJa: 治療台に寝かされていた
findings.governingReading: Sakura finds herself laid out on a treatment table.
findings.explanation: The English says she is sleeping despite the line occurring after she opens her eyes, and changes treatment to surgery.

findings.highlight: a black priest she has never seen before
findings.evidenceJa: 自分と同じような、見たことのない神父
findings.governingReading: Sakura sees an unknown priest who is “black” in a way resembling herself.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the self-comparison that motivates her perception of Kirei.

findings.highlight: It’s my body. I know all about it
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の体です、ちゃんと判っています
findings.governingReading: Sakura says it is her own body and she properly understands its condition.
findings.explanation: “Know all about it” overstates her knowledge as exhaustive.

findings.highlight: You cannot run after that if you are naked
findings.evidenceJa: その格好では逃げる事もできない
findings.governingReading: Kirei says Sakura cannot flee in her present state or attire.
findings.explanation: A conditional English variant explicitly makes Sakura naked.

findings.highlight: Emiya Shirou will suffer more if you live
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎も苦しむだろう
findings.governingReading: If Sakura lives, Shirou too will suffer.
findings.explanation: The English adds a comparative increase not stated in the source.

findings.highlight: her, hugging her knees on the operating table
findings.evidenceJa: 治療台で自身を抱く少女
findings.governingReading: The girl holds or embraces herself on the treatment table.
findings.explanation: The English specifies her knees, narrowing and restaging Sakura’s defensive posture.

findings.highlight: He smiles and leaves
findings.evidenceJa: 陰鬱な笑いをかみ殺しながら
findings.governingReading: Kirei suppresses a gloomy or sinister laugh as he leaves for the courtyard.
findings.explanation: The English replaces restrained dark laughter with an ordinary smile and omits his destination.
